findings.assertion: Fixed torus derivatives and source-independent constants. The original reviewer inspected inverse_finiteJets/mixedJet_inverse_bound; this retrospective additionally checks norm_derivativeWord_inverse_le. No claim of exhaustive counterpart search.
findings.evidence: Formal SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.inverse_finiteJets and mixedJet_inverse_bound inspected here use five additional torus derivatives. Prose (8.19) states four, which is independently justified by O(|k|) divisor loss plus a summable |k|^-3 series in dimension two. Thus inspected formal theorem gives weaker derivative count, sufficient for the all-orders coefficient classes; exact four-loss formal counterpart remains unlocated.
